record.original_question: Let Delta be a centrally symmetric simplicial sphere, so Delta admits a fixed-point-free involution alpha on its vertex set, and let Theta = theta_1, ..., theta_d be a linear system of parameters chosen generically from S^- = {f in S : alpha(f) = -f}. With respect to the linear form w = x1 + ... + xn, does the Artinian reduction S/(I_Delta + (Theta)) always have the strong or weak Lefschetz property?

evidence.quote: Problem 4.3. Let ∆ be a centrally symmetric simplicial sphere and let Θ = θ1, . . . , θd be a linear system of parameters for K[∆] that has been generically taken from S−. Does the algebra S/(I∆ + (Θ)) have the SLP or WLP with respect to the linear form w = x1 + · · · + xn?

A simplicial complex ∆ on vertex set [n] is said to be centrally symmetric (cs, for short) if it admits a free Z/2Z-action, that is, there is a fixed-point free involution α : [n] → [n] with ∆ = {α(F) | F ∈ ∆}. For such a simplicial complex, one can choose a linear system of parameters Θ = θ1, . . . , θd from S− = {f ∈ S | α(f) = −f}, where α(xv) is defined to be xα(v).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Delta$ be a centrally symmetric simplicial sphere of dimension $d-1$ on the vertex set $[n] = \{1,\dots,n\}$; that is, $\Delta$ is a simplicial complex whose geometric realization is homeomorphic to a $(d-1)$-sphere, equipped with a fixed-point-free involution $\alpha : [n] \to [n]$ satisfying $\Delta = \{\alpha(F) : F \in \Delta\}$. Let $\mathbb{K}$ be an infinite field of characteristic $0$, and let $S = \mathbb{K}[x_1, \dots, x_n]$ with the involution $\alpha$ extended to $S$ via $\alpha(x_v) = x_{\alpha(v)}$. Define 
$$S^{-} = \{ f \in S : \alpha(f) = -f \}.$$
Let $I_\Delta \subset S$ be the Stanley–Reisner ideal of $\Delta$, and let $\Theta = \theta_1, \dots, \theta_d \in S^{-}_1$ be a linear system of parameters for the face ring $\mathbb{K}[\Delta] = S/I_\Delta$ chosen generically from the degree-$1$ part of $S^{-}$. Form the Artinian reduction
$$A = S/(I_\Delta + (\Theta)).$$
Set $w = x_1 + x_2 + \cdots + x_n \in S$. Recall that $A$ has the weak Lefschetz property (WLP) with respect to $w$ if, for every $i$, the multiplication map $w : A_i \to A_{i+1}$ has full rank, and the strong Lefschetz property (SLP) with respect to $w$ if, for every $i \le j$, the map $w^{j-i} : A_i \to A_j$ has full rank.

Question: Does $A$ always satisfy the strong Lefschetz property, or at least the weak Lefschetz property, with respect to $w$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question concerning Lefschetz properties for Artinian reductions of face rings of centrally symmetric simplicial spheres via parameters from the antiinvariant space $S^-$. Related work establishes generic anisotropy and Lefschetz properties for various classes of simplicial spheres, but no source located resolves the centrally symmetric SLP/WLP question in this generic-$S^-$ setting. The status appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: A tale of centrally symmetric polytopes and spheres
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on centrally symmetric polytopes and spheres, including Lefschetz-type questions for face rings under generic linear systems of parameters from S^-.
status_evidence.claim: The Lefschetz property for cs simplicial spheres with parameters from S^- is discussed as an open direction.

status_evidence.title: Coinvariant stresses, Lefschetz properties and random complexes
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Lefschetz properties for simplicial complexes; related but does not resolve the cs sphere case with S^- parameters.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to investigate generic Lefschetz properties for simplicial spheres without settling the cs case.
